summary: From the black of a waste port that snaps shut, the camera pulls back to reveal red amniotic gel flowing into a pod a diminutive infant nursing from its feeding tube. Over this image, Morpheus recounts how he came to believe the truth: seeing the fields where the dead are liquefied to be fed intravenously to the living, and recognizing the horrifying precision of it. As the pull-back continues, the power-plant image is revealed to be on a television screen, and the scene shifts back to the construct's white void.
